localizedValues.name: S1
localizedValues.description: First shelter built at Illahee State Park.  The log style construction was complete by the WPA in 1937.  There is one electrical outlet. Horseshoe pit and restroom nearby.

localizedValues.name: S2
localizedValues.description: This shelter is newer construction with a private setting including views of the water.  It is located a little further walk from the parking areas.  There are eight electrical outlets and lights. Restrooms nearby.

localizedValues.name: S3
localizedValues.description: The largest shelter in the park, centrally located near the playground, volleyball court and restrooms.  There are two electrical outlets and a sink in this shelter.
